name: PTT Youngin$ Illegal Goods Store raid
summary: An Ultimate Edition raid on the compound of a Southside Vice City gang: get in, get out safely, and keep the special items and contraband.
body: Rockstar calls the gang one of Southside Vice City's loudest and most socially active. Its image caption names them the PTT Youngin$.

name: Classic Car Collection
summary: An Ultimate Edition commission from Wyman, a collector and local fixer: find abandoned classics and unfinished project cars and restore them.
